drifted.spec_text: **Open:** with the documented FlushManager::trigger_flush() trigger, flush failures are not propagated (src/flush.rs:177) — see drift-report 2026-10-14 / proposal P1
drifted.actual: trigger_flush returns Err(last_error) when the pass that released it failed; force_flush maps it to StorageError; tested

drifted.spec_text: FlushManager performs a final flush on Drop (graceful shutdown); recommended trigger is move || flush_manager.trigger_flush()
drifted.actual: With that trigger and FlushManager callbacks capturing Arc<component>, component -> flush_trigger -> FlushManager -> worker -> callbacks -> component is a reference cycle; the FlushManager is never dropped, the final flush never runs, the worker thread leaks (polls every 10 ms)

drifted.spec_text: Recovery falls back to inactive region if active region is corrupt; verify header CRC and entry CRCs
drifted.actual: Only a bad header or flush_seq mismatch causes fallback; bad-CRC entries are skipped one sector at a time, silently

drifted.spec_text: Crash consistency: partial flush never corrupts previously-committed data
drifted.actual: After a fallback recovery the superblock is returned unchanged; the next flush overwrites the region just recovered; a crash mid-flush then loses everything

drifted.spec_text: put(key, value) stores arbitrary binary data (0 to 128 KiB) by string key
drifted.actual: Keys > 65535 bytes accepted; key_len truncated to u16 on serialize; entry lost on restart
